observed_gaps.evidence: CodingToolState::authorize_mutation_locked permits a mutation without a workflow below plan_file_threshold.
WorkflowPlan stores tests and validation as free text; CodingWorkflow::begin_review only requires one successful current-revision validation.
CodingWorkflow retains an objective and plan but no requirement-level status or evidence model.
Repeated normalized diagnostics and repeated process invocations stop the workflow, but strategy choice and hypothesis evidence are not represented in workflow state.

constraints: No installed application under /Applications was modified.
